_comment: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\CyberWarden\ArtifactSigning\config.json (or point CW_SIGN_CONFIG at it). Identifiers only - never put a secret, key or password here. Keep it out of Git. Signing happens ONLY when Mode is exactly "Required"; with "Off" the other fields are not even checked.
ExpectedCommonName: <your validated legal name exactly as in the certificate CN, without 'CN='>
